summary: SiteProfileHistory handles the historical actions performed on site profiles, including tracking changes by users and agencies.
purpose: To track and manage the history of changes made to site profiles within the HSPnet framework.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site profile history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date when the action was performed.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the screen where the action took place.

fields.name: UserAction
fields.description: Description of the action performed by the user.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Fields affected by the user action.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Phone contact details of the user.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID of the person who performed the action.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: User ID of the original user who performed the action, if different.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating if the user is a system administrator.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Initiate search with SiteID and SessionAgencyID parameters.
Retrieve historical entries from the database.
Localize data if alternate language fields are enabled.

business_rules.name: SysAdmin Visibility
business_rules.description: SysAdmin user actions are displayed differently in history.
